propositions: An isolated GitHub Actions adapter must parse coverage percentage from pytest-cov TOTAL line in run-log tail and extract CI-health metadata (status, duration, red-to-green recovery interval, recheck/flake rate) from run-metadata JSON.

A harvest script (harvest_gha.py) must pull recent test.yml run logs and metadata via the GHA API and persist them as labeled snapshots to the git-tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson store, not to the gitignored reports/ directory.
The core metrics modules (registry.py, __init__.py, and future _commands/metrics.py) must not import the GHA adapter to maintain isolation and portability for alternative CI adapters.

Unit tests must verify the adapter extracts coverage (e.g. 84.2%) from fixture log text and computes red-to-green recovery duration from fixture fail-then-pass run pairs, with emitted records carrying the snapshot label.
